_note: TemplateManifestSchema (packages/spec/src/marketplace/template-manifest.zod.ts) — `objectstack.manifest.json`, the package-listing file an author writes beside objectstack.config.ts. Read by `os package publish` (packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts) and by create-objectstack at scaffold; parsed for every shipped file by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:template-manifests`; never loaded by a runtime boot. GOVERNED VIA THE GATE'S SPEC-ONLY OVERRIDE (SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS), seeded 2026-11-06 with the marketplace taxonomy, whose facet keys (`businessFunctions`, `industries`, `solutionType`, `maturity`) have their consumers in the cloud catalog (objectstack-ai/cloud#3661) and the console — a row is where those consumers are named. MEASUREMENT: every row below was measured for this seeding against objectstack origin/main 7d9682ffd7 plus the taxonomy change, and the cloud leg against cloud origin/main 8f574b9 (its publish route reads `tags` and the category it retires; it drops every facet key today). The `dead` rows other than `category` are what entering the denominator found: `name`, `specVersion`, `skills`, `scaffold` and `visibility` were then retired as tombstones (ADR-0049, D3 `marketplace-template-manifest-inert-keys-retired`); `publisher` and `isStarter`, which only the platform decides, were retired after them as their own family (D3 `marketplace-template-manifest-platform-decided-keys-retired`, maintainer ruling 6708417668).

businessFunctions.note: 1-3 business functions, the primary first; required to submit to the marketplace (the cloud submit policy, cloud#3661). CONSUMERS (named per the marketplace-taxonomy ruling): the cloud catalog stores and filters it — objectstack-ai/cloud#3661, not landed at cloud origin/main 8f574b9, whose publish route picks named body keys and drops this one today — and the console marketplace (`ui/`), whose facet filters, badges and labels are the console card the repo:cloud#3 seat files from the taxonomy PR. IN THIS REPO: `os package publish` judges the value with the spec's own schema and forwards it under its wire name (`readPublishTaxonomy`), so a malformed value is refused before any network call — a gate, not a consumer. Flip to `live` with a cloud-attributed pointer when cloud#3661 lands.

publisher.note: REMOVED 2026-11-07 — tombstoned at the schema (retiredKey carries the prescription; authoring it is a tsc error and a parse error). No D2 conversion: this file is not a stack collection member (D3 `marketplace-template-manifest-platform-decided-keys-retired`). The entry stays because retiredKey keeps the key in the walked shape; the platform assigns the trust tier from the publisher's credentials, and `os package publish` refuses the file's key by name before any network call. Before retiring it was read only to be named in a warning (`uncarriedManifestWarnings`, PLATFORM_DECIDED_MANIFEST_KEYS) and never sent; a first-party publish script (objectstack-ai/hotcrm scripts/lib/marketplace-listing.mjs#packageUpsertBody) read it off its own manifest, and moves it into the script (maintainer ruling 6708417668). The publish request's own `publisher` (CreatePackageRequestSchema) is untouched.
